info.name: Alacena GraphQL - Todas las APIs
info.description: Coleccion GraphQL para probar todas las operaciones expuestas por los resolvers del proyecto Alacena. Ejecuta primero Setup y Auth. La URL usa {{baseUrl}}/graphql.

request.description: Inicializa variables para correr la coleccion varias veces y valida que /graphql responda.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "mutation Register($input: RegisterDto!) {\n  register(input: $input) {\n    access_token\n    user { id email first_name last_name role }\n  }\n}",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "email": "{{userEmail}}",
      "password": "{{password}}",
      "first_name": "Usuario",
      "last_name": "Prueba",
      "phone_number": "+573001112233",
      "birth_date": "1998-05-14",
      "sex": "Hombre",
      "weight_kg": 70,
      "height_cm": 175,
      "activity_level": "Moderado",
      "goal": "Mantener",
      "diet_type": "Sin_dieta",
      "excluded_ingredients": [],
      "excluded_categories": []
    }
  }
}

request.description: Reemplaza code por el codigo real recibido.
Cuidado: elimina el usuario indicado. Usalo al final.
Usalo al final si quieres limpiar el producto creado.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "mutation CreateRecipe($input: CreateRecipeInput!) {
  createRecipe(input: $input) { id
name
description
category
difficulty
preparationTime
cookingTime
servings
rating
ratingCount
isPublic
isCustom
niCalories
niProtein
niCarbohydrates
niFat
ingredients {
  id
  genericName
  productId
  quantity
  unit
}
steps {
  id
  order
  description
  duration
}
user {
  id
  email
} }
}",
  "variables": {
    "input": {
      "name": "Ensalada {{runSuffix}}",
      "description": "Receta de prueba",
      "category": "salads",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "preparationTime": 10,
      "cookingTime": 0,
      "servings": 2,
      "isPublic": true,
      "niCalories": 250,
      "niProtein": 6,
      "niCarbohydrates": 30,
      "niFat": 10
    }
  }
}
